AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.subtitle: The Story of Arabic Academy
AboutPage.story2: It all started with a simple question: 'Why is it so hard to find clear, high-quality materials for learning Arabic specifically for Russian speakers?'
AboutPage.story3: Most courses are either too expensive, not adapted, or require translation from English. I decided to change this. My goal is to create an accessible, clear, and modern platform where every Russian speaker can learn Arabic without stress and huge costs.
AboutPage.philosophy: My philosophy is simple: quality education should be accessible to everyone. That's why all lessons are currently completely free. Join us, learn, and help improve the platform with your feedback!
AboutPage.missionDesc: Teach Arabic to Russian speakers in a modern and simple way
AboutPage.visionDesc: Help 10 million Russian speakers master Arabic
